purpose: Bind all twelve scenarios to space, minimum data, human responsibility, acceptance, pause, and fallback.
claim_boundary: Participant-authored operating contract only. It defines role types, records, pause conditions, and evidence needed for later professional work. It does not name real institutions, certify products, authorize treatment, approve construction, or claim field performance.

scenarios.name_zh: 公众报修与透明保修台
scenarios.name_en: Public fault intake and transparent warranty
scenarios.observable_proxy: method defined; no local baseline or target asserted
stop_conditions: immediate danger, no human route, or ownership conflict
scenarios.manual_fallback: staffed equivalent service and complaint route
scenarios.complaint_route: staffed intake or independent escalation appropriate to the service
scenarios.evidence_record: S01 gate trail plus return-to-service or handover receipt
